prompt:
Top-down editorial still photograph. A single sheet of matte uncoated off-white paper lies flat on a seamless vivid tomato red-orange (#F2552C) paper backdrop, slightly rotated (about 4 degrees). Hard late-morning sunlight from the upper left casts a crisp, soft-edged diagonal window-light shadow across one corner of the frame.
The sheet is a company admin view for a training cohort, a seat list with a cohort start date. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Cohort starts Mon, Nov 2"; "Seats · 24 of 25 assigned"; "Add a seat". One small tomato red-orange (#F2552C) printed highlight on the "Add a seat" button.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Calm, minimal, high-end print photography with natural paper texture.
